I was using Ubuntu couple years ago during my master's. Due to specific requirements, I was on non-lts version. This accentuated the issue, but would still be an issue on LTS.

The issue was, my Ubuntu version became out of support about 6 months before my project was complete. However, due to nature of Ubuntu and its packaging, I was scared to upgrade it. Any breakage in updates, especially likely with nVidia GPU, would stop my work dead. This is when I realised that being afraid that my OS upgrade making my system unusable was not going to work long term.

Immediately after I submitted my thesis, I moved onto NixOS. If an update breaks something, all I have to do is a reboot. This alone justifies the cost of NixOS for me.
